payload.abstract: This dataset is an automated ETL conversion of the MIMIC-IV Clinical Database Demo into the Medical Event Data Standard (MEDS). MEDS is a data schema for storing streams of medical events such as those sourced from Electronic Health Records or claims records. MEDS is intentionally a minimal standard, designed for maximum interoperability across datasets, existing tools, and model architectures. By providing a simple standardization layer between datasets and model-specific code, MEDS is intended to help make machine learning research for EHR data more reproducible, robust, computationally performant, and collaborative.
